text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you both! Did you come all the 
way here just to tell me?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to invite Biko-chan right now and 
head out together! First to the zoo, and 
then let's have some cake at a cafe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin over to karaoke next! And our 
goal line will be the present exchange!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's quite a packed list! Perfect 
chance to show off our speed!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course, while making sure to have fun. 
I even put together a birthday outfit in 
super happy colors♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm getting all dressed up, I wanna go 
to an amusement park! They're doing a 
Carrotman collab right now!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And I want to buy yogurt at the farm... 
Oh, let's stop by a toy store too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I shall accompany you to the ends of the 
earth! Let us Bakushin to our hearts' 
content!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the birthday tour is underway! 
Pegasus Daaaaaash!!
